decision: Freeze COPD V1 at git commit 875e995406ddf5d00ce77920d9e650ff128604c0
rationale: Preserves the original autonomous workflow, result meanings, thresholds, negative findings, and 337-candidate order.
applies_to: All V1 files under diseases/COPD except 07_gap_closure

decision: Use only the COPD-V2 identifier namespace for new work
rationale: Prevents collision with or reinterpretation of COPD-S1 through COPD-S6 results.

decision: Planning phase permits only inspection, metadata verification, and small feasibility diagnostics
rationale: The investigator requested a scientific plan before any major analysis, training, large download, reranking, or manuscript rewrite.

decision: Keep evidence classes and evidence scope separate
rationale: Association, LD, fine-mapping, prediction, QTL, colocalization, contact, motif, occupancy, reporter, regional perturbation, allele editing, and disease evidence are not interchangeable.
V2 may add a separate evidence view keyed to the frozen record but cannot present it as the V1 rank or a posterior probability.

decision: Require phenotype-compatible full locus statistics and suitable LD/QTL data before fine-mapping or colocalization
rationale: Significant hits, unsigned r-squared links, exact eQTL overlap, or mismatched reference LD cannot support these labels.

decision: Execute accession-level phenotype adjudication and frozen strict-support sensitivity first
rationale: Phenotype heterogeneity materially drives the tag universe and final candidate support.
applies_to: Module C after investigator approves primary versus secondary phenotype strata

decision: Benchmark frozen models against full tested/null COPD functional panels and audit reverse-complement concordance
rationale: Provides high-information, low-cost sensitivity and mechanism diagnostics without tuning V1.
applies_to: Module A and new model-orientation gap

decision: Run isolated same-donor accessible-control and same-lobe multi-seed sensitivity models
rationale: V1 controls rarely overlap donor ATAC, so held-out discrimination may partly reflect source/accessibility.
applies_to: New model-control gap; no V1 replacement

decision: Train additional regulatory-context models only from coherent same-donor compatible assay sets
rationale: No complete technically compatible alternative context triplet was established during planning.

decision: Limit statistical fine-mapping to phenotype-specific loci with complete statistics and matched LD
rationale: The heterogeneous V1 union and thresholded unsigned 1000 Genomes links cannot support credible sets or PIPs.
applies_to: Module D; whole-V1 fine-mapping is NO-GO

decision: Crosswalk published COPD molecular-QTL colocalization and lung rE2G before new de novo target analyses
rationale: These resources provide high-value target/mechanism information at low compute while preserving evidence class and scope.

decision: Use Module F only after evidence-producing modules and never create an omnibus validation score
rationale: Synthesis adds no independent evidence and can otherwise double-count correlated sources.
